about: The one model picker's words (owner 2026-11-24: one set of thinking labels in both pickers). The agent chats' picker and Work's (T3 Code's own) show a thinking level by these labels, keyed by the id the provider sends; the id itself is never changed. An id not listed here keeps its provider's label. `aliases` folds a provider's spelling onto one id. Quick / Balanced / Thorough everywhere, with Extra thorough and Maximum only where a model offers them. `lineup` and `taglines` are Atum's own models' one-line descriptions. atum-work keeps a byte-identical copy (atum-work/model-picker-labels.json); each repo's tests check both copies' digests against model-picker-digests.json.
